description: House-level files lampstand init plants at the root of a house. Each entry copies template to destination, only when the destination is missing. The dotfiles are stored without their leading dot and with a .txt suffix: a .gitignore or .gitattributes here would apply to this repository's own tree, npm leaves a packaged .gitignore out, and Hermes's install scanner reads a .txt file but skips a name with no extension.
